thesis: Moral education can omit conditions and asymmetric exceptions; suspicion must remain falsifiable and the narrator acknowledges benefiting too.

ideas.statement: Virtues can transfer peace costs to cooperative people, while indiscriminate distrust is also exploitable.
Public principles and tacit exceptions can emerge without conspiracy; sincere self-justification and invisible work complicate blame.
Philosophical genealogy and interest do not settle truth or social function; origins and justified application require distinct inquiries.
Local exploitation does not prove all morality fraudulent; universal cynicism can become an unfalsifiable prestige identity.
